content: The texts were tokenized and lemmatized with the UDPipe models for the respective languages trained on the Universal Dependencies 2.3 treebanks BIBREF5. UDPipe yields lemmatization accuracy about 96% for English and 97% for Russian; thus for the task at hand, we considered it to be gold and did not try to further improve the quality of normalisation itself (although it is not entirely error-free, see Section SECREF4).
